profile.headline: Systems Software Engineer @ Pantex Plant
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at the Pantex Plant under the Department of Energy, I've worn many hats, contributing to the development and maintenance of mission-critical applications across .NET, SAP, and PeopleSoft platforms. As part of a core team, I played a pivotal role in driving key initiatives that enhanced operational efficiency and reduced downtime across multiple departments. My involvement in managing the onboarding of distributed systems during site transitions was crucial in ensuring that these systems were robust, secure, and optimized for performance. Additionally, I led efforts to develop .NET applications interfacing with SAP systems, aligning our work with the strategic objectives of the National Nuclear Security Administration.

In my previous role as a Computer Science Educator at Pampa Independent School District, I took on a significant leadership role, teaching and mentoring a large number of students. My dedication to education and mentorship was recognized when I received the "Distinguished Educator Award" in my second year of teaching. I developed and implemented innovative curricula that greatly improved student comprehension and performance in programming. Leading by example, I fostered a learning environment that encouraged curiosity, critical thinking, and a deep understanding of computer science principles. I also coached the UIL Computer Science team, where my strategic guidance and advanced training techniques led to a top-4 regional ranking and significant improvements in team performance.

Earlier in my career, as a Social Media Analyst Intern at Provo Recreation Center, I managed cross-functional teams to integrate Python-based tools for customer engagement analysis, resulting in a notable increase in social media reach. My ability to lead teams and drive targeted strategies led to improved customer engagement through tailored content.

With a proven track record of leadership in both technical and educational environments, I excel at managing teams, optimizing processes, and driving successful outcomes. My expertise spans Java, C#, .NET, SAP/ABAP, PeopleSoft, and cloud platforms like Azure DevOps. Fluent in Spanish and committed to continuous improvement, I am passionate about leading teams to achieve excellence and deliver impactful results.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Serve as technical lead for the plant's pension benefits system, a business-critical .NET application integrating SAP serving ~1000 active and retired employees; direct the team owning its development, end-user support, and debugging, including active integration with a newly onboarded system.

Developed solutions for the pension service from Y12 during the Pantex–Y12 organizational split and brought it fully in-house, building the team's capability to independently own and manage the system. 

Modernized the pension system from a deprecated to a fully functioning state with zero interruption to service.

Led technical ownership and management of the plant's property management application, a second .NET system.

Supported the SAP HCM cutover during the Y12 separation; resolved HCM service errors and developed custom ABAP programs to extend functionality.

positions.title: System Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and developed fixes for the plant's supply-chain management system (C#.NET, PeopleCode): resolved production errors and corrected database schema issues.

Supported the internal tools team by managing key PeopleSoft jobs and maintaining connectivity and data accuracy between the supply-chain system and PeopleSoft.

positions.title: Computer Science Educator
positions.description:
Designed and taught computer science coursework spanning algorithmic foundations through full-stack web development, translating complex technical concepts for students across a wide range of skill levels; 9 of 11 students (82%) passed the AP Computer Science exam.

Grew introductory course enrollment ~29% year over year (34 to 44 students). Mentored students toward technical careers: of the initial AP cohort, 5 pursued computer science majors and several others went on to other STEM fields.
Awarded the district's Distinguished Educator Award in second year for exceptional contribution to student success.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Java · Algorithms · Technical Documentation · Project Management · Python (Programming Language) · Web Development · Software Project Management

positions.title: Social Media Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented python-based member measurement tools to analyze customer engagement, resulting in a 15% increase in social media reach.
• Conducted demographic analyses using sentiment tools to gain insights into the target audience, leading to improved tailored content that increased engagement by 20%.
• Led cross-functional teams to integrate member measurement and sentiment tools across multiple social media channels, improving understanding of customer behavior and driving informed business decisions.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Data Analysis · Analytical Skills · Technical Documentation · Python (Programming Language) · Data Entry · Digital Strategy

positions.title: Publicity Assistant
positions.description:
Performed media relations for BYU’s performing groups in 8 countries. 
Engaged with international media for publicity of 17 touring groups. 
Maintained the website and created news releases for all of BYU’s 20 performing groups as well as publicity materials for performances.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Documentation · Project Management · Microsoft Office

company.name: Brigham Young University Performing Arts Management

positions.title: Public Relations Researcher
positions.description:
Coordinated 2 focus groups and coordinated the delivery of a mass survey for a client in discovering brand image problems. 
Worked with a 7-person team to develop a comprehensive report about communications problems the client was having and subsequent solutions to those problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Documentation · Statistical Data Analysis · Project Management · IBM SPSS · Microsoft Office · Market Research
